title: Per-hook ActionCable consumers are never disconnected on unmount
reasoning: The hook creates a new ActionCable consumer for each subscription effect, but cleanup only unsubscribes the subscription and drops the ref. The consumer object is not retained or disconnected, so repeated mounts or channel changes can leave unused consumer connections alive depending on ActionCable connection behavior. The test mock even exposes disconnect but no test asserts it is called.
recommendation: Store the consumer created in the effect and call consumer.disconnect() in cleanup after unsubscribing, or centralize ActionCable consumer creation so subscriptions share a managed singleton.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The useActionCable tests verify subscription and message handling only; they do not unmount and assert unsubscribe/disconnect behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a useActionCable unmount test using the mocked consumer that asserts unsubscribe and disconnect are both called exactly once.
minimumFixScope: app/hooks/useActionCable.ts cleanup plus one test in app/hooks/__tests__/useActionCable.test.ts
